name: War Horse
description: A warhorse is a large, powerful horse bred and trained for battle. It is typically stronger and more robust than a regular horse, often equipped with armor.

actions.name: Trample
actions.description: The war horse tramples a creature that is medium or smaller, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Buck
actions.description: When a creature moves in or out of the war horse's area of control, it bucks its hind legs, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Charge
actions.description: The war horse moves up to it's full walk speed in a straight line. If the war horse collides with a medium or smaller creature, that creature must make a contested shove check or they take physical damage and are displaced 1 unit. If a creature succeeds on the check, the charge ends. The damage bonus modifier on this ability is equal to the units traveled.

traits.name: Battlebred
traits.description: The war horse is bred for battle and has had the fear trained out of it. While mounted, the war horse is immune to the afraid condition.
